findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：部分關鍵原料為單一或少數供應商，且部分原料受原產國出口限制，可能造成出貨延遲或毛利下降。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, some required raw materials are subject to export restrictions imposed by their country of origin.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：全球營運受 CBP、BIS、OFAC 等進出口法規約束，更高關稅或新貿易障礙、反傾銷等可能對業務與財務造成負面影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The implementation of more restrictive trade policies, such as higher tariffs or new barriers to entry, together with anti-dumping claims, duties, slowed regulatory approvals and other restrictions, in countries in which we import raw materials and components or sell large quantities of products and services could negatively impact our business, results of operations and financial condition.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未見 Corning 被列入 Entity List 或 2026 年新增針對性出口管制；中國 2025-09 對美國單模光纖課反規避稅（約 37.9%，至 2028-04）與 Section 232 太陽能／多晶矽相關正面報導，只拿到搜尋摘要摘要、無逐字原文，列為 clues。

clues.claim: Corning Q3 2026 新聞稿：美國 Section 232 行動改善美製太陽能產品的價格環境與需求。
CEO Weeks 稱約 90% 營收來自美國內、僅約 1% 美國銷售來自中國工廠，關稅暴露有限。
clues.source: 24/7 Wall St，Corning's Tariff Immunity Comes Down to One Strategic Choice

clues.claim: 中國商務部對美國單模光纖課反規避關稅，Corning 適用 37.9%，至 2028-04-21。
clues.source: Bloomberg Law，China Hits US Optical Fiber Imports With Anti-Dumping Duties
